title: Payload at the Input Head
statement: Let $S$ be a type, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes on the input obtained by embedding each bit of $x$ into the simulation alphabet. Suppose $j\le |x|$ and the input head of $c$ is at position $j+1$. The pair whose content is the decoded clock bit of the symbol read and whose tag is $2$ when that read is blank and $0$ otherwise equals the virtual input payload of $x$ at coordinate $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration on the letterwise embedded input, with $k$ work tapes
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word embedded into the simulation alphabet and let a
configuration on the embedded input have its input head at position $j + 1$ with
$j \le |x|$.  Then the payload whose content is the clock-bit decoding of the
input read and whose tag is the right-boundary tag $2$ when the read is blank
and the ordinary tag $0$ otherwise is exactly the virtual input payload of $x$
at position $j$.
